title: Syrian Kabanos Wrap
description: A flavorful Middle Eastern-inspired wrap filled with spicy kabanos and gooey cheese.
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill kabanos sausages for 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
Slice grilled kabanos into thin rounds.
Warm wrap bread by wrapping in foil and heating in the oven for 5 minutes.
Spread Syrian olive tapenade on flatbread, leaving a small border around the edges.
Arrange grilled kabanos slices on top of the tapenade.
Crumble gooey feta cheese over the kabanos.
Serve immediately, folding wrap in half to enclose the filling.
